00.name: Lumberjack
00.text: Huph. Huph. guys wait up. Stop walking so fast.

01.name: Sweat
01.text: No dilly dallying mortal, lord Pasta awaits.

02.name: Sour
02.text: Remember this pain lumberer next time you side with Sweat.

04.name: Narrator
04.text: The edge of the forest comes into sight as your group continues to march forward.
